verified_key_information_units.information: The Group's unaudited consolidated net turnover for Q4 2024/2025 was EUR 5.18 million, representing a 13% decrease compared to Q4 2023/2024, with a Q4 loss of EUR 913 thousand. For the full 2024/2025 financial year, consolidated turnover declined 4% to EUR 26.11 million with a loss of EUR 820 thousand (vs EUR 2.37 million loss in prior year).
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report page 7: 'The Group's unaudited consolidated net turnover for the fourth quarter (Q4) of the 2024/2025 financial year (FY) was EUR 5.18 million, representing a 13% decrease compared to the same period in FY 2023/2024.' and 'The Group closed the fourth quarter of the 2024/2025 financial year with a loss of EUR 913 thousand (unaudited).' Also page 7: 'The consolidated unaudited result for the twelve months of the 2024/2025 financial year is a loss of EUR 820 thousand. The Group reported a loss of EUR 2.37 million for the 2023/2024 financial year.' KEY indicators page 10 shows net profit/(loss) data.

candidate_sentences.text: SAF Tehnika reported a challenging financial performance for the 2024/2025 fiscal year, characterized by a decline in revenue and a net loss, although the loss was significantly narrower than in the previous period.
The Group’s consolidated net turnover for the twelve months ended June 30, 2025, amounted to EUR 26.11 million, representing a 4% decrease compared to EUR 27.09 million in the prior year.
The Group recorded a net loss of EUR 820 thousand for the full year, a substantial improvement from the EUR 2.37 million loss reported in 2023/2024.

However, the fourth quarter of the 2024/2025 fiscal year was particularly weak, with quarterly revenue dropping 13% to EUR 5.18 million and a net loss of EUR 913 thousand, compared to a loss of EUR 498 thousand in the same quarter of the previous year.

verified_key_information_units.information: Regional turnover performance showed significant divergence: North America/Latin America (47% of Q4 revenue at EUR 2.5 million) decreased 40% YoY; Europe (36% at EUR 1.9 million) increased 24% YoY; Asia/Africa/Middle East (16% at EUR 846k) doubled compared to prior year Q4.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report page 7: 'The turnover of the North America and Latin America region amounted to 47% or EUR 2.5 million. Compared to the same quarter of the previous financial year, the turnover has decreased by 40%.' and 'The European region accounted for 36% of turnover, amounting to EUR 1.9 million, an increase of 24% compared with the fourth quarter of the previous financial year.' and 'Turnover in the Asia, Africa and Middle East region doubled compared with the corresponding quarter of the previous financial year, representing 16% of the total quarterly turnover (or EUR 846 thousand).'

candidate_sentences.text: This contraction was primarily driven by a 14% decline in the North and Latin American regions, where revenue fell to EUR 14.28 million.
Conversely, the European market demonstrated resilience, with turnover increasing by 17% to EUR 10.04 million, while the Asia, Africa, and Middle East region saw a modest 5% decline.

verified_key_information_units.information: Quarterly turnover fluctuations are driven by project completion timing, with dispatch and revenue recognition often occurring in subsequent quarters due to production durations and material lead times.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report page 7: 'As noted in previous reports, fluctuations in quarterly turnover are influenced by the completion of individual projects. Projects can vary in scope and complexity, and their execution is influenced by both the duration of the production process and the lead times for material procurement. As a result, the dispatch of goods and the recognition of revenue often take place only in subsequent quarters.'

verified_key_information_units.information: The Group maintained liquidity with EUR 4.8 million cash balance and EUR 3.9 million in customer advances, supported by an unused EUR 4.95 million credit line with Luminor Bank. Net cash flow for the year was EUR 2.6 million.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report page 7: 'The Group's cash balance in the balance sheet at the end of the period was EUR 4.8 million. Advances received from customers for goods totaled EUR 3.9 million.' and 'To ensure liquidity, the Parent Company has a Credit Line Agreement with Luminor Bank AS for a total amount of EUR 4.95 million, which had not been utilised at the end of the reporting period.' Cash flow statement page 15: 'Net cash flow for the 12 months of the financial year is EUR 2.6 million.'

candidate_sentences.text: The Group generated a positive net cash flow of EUR 2.6 million for the year, largely supported by strong cash generation from operations and advances received from customers, which totaled EUR 3.9 million.
The cash balance at the end of the period reached EUR 4.8 million, up from EUR 2.2 million in the previous year.
The company maintains a EUR 4.95 million credit line with Luminor Bank, which remained undrawn, providing ample liquidity.

verified_key_information_units.information: Operations were affected by global electronic components shortage, though delivery times have recently improved. The Group continues investing in new product development and sales promotion across existing and new market segments.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report page 7: 'The Group's operations were affected by the global shortage of various electronic components. During the previous period, the company accumulated material reserves to be able to fulfill the majority of orders, ensuring short, or customer-expected, delivery times. Delivery times have continued to improve recently.' and 'The Group continues to invest in new product development and product enhancements, as well as in sales promotion across both existing and new market segments.'

candidate_sentences.text: The company continued to invest in product development and sales promotion, ensuring that expenses did not exceed budgeted amounts.
The Group also faced headwinds from the global shortage of electronic components, although it had accumulated material reserves to maintain delivery times, which have recently improved.

verified_key_information_units.information: Products were sold in 75 countries during Q4, with no direct impact from armed conflict regions (Russia, Ukraine, Belarus), though general business environment uncertainty persists. The microwave radio market showed no major changes during the quarter.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report page 7: 'In the reporting quarter, the Group’s products were sold in 75 countries.' Market Overview page 8: 'During the quarter, there were no major changes in the microwave radio market.' and 'The Group has no clients or suppliers in the region affected by armed conflict (Russia, Ukraine, or Belarus); therefore, no impact on order volumes has been observed.' Guidelines page 9: 'Although the hostilities in Ukraine do not directly impact the Group’s operations, overall uncertainty in the business environment persists.'

verified_key_information_units.information: The Group consists of three product categories: digital microwave radio equipment, microwave spectrum analyzers/signal generators, and wireless sensor network solutions for environmental monitoring, sold globally to public and private sectors.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Key data page 1: 'SAF Tehnika (hereinafter – the Group) is a manufacturer of wireless data transmission equipment. The company’s activities can be divided into three categories: § Digital microwave radio equipment for voice and data transmission. § Microwave spectrum analyzers and signal generators. § Wireless sensor network solutions for environmental monitoring.' Also states products are used by both the public and private sectors in areas such as mobile communications, internet service providing, industrial production, finance, horticulture, media and many others.

verified_key_information_units.information: Q4 fixed asset investments totaled EUR 239 thousand primarily for production/testing processes and office equipment acquisition.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report page 7: 'In Q4 of the 2024/2025 financial year, EUR 239 thousand were invested in the purchase of fixed assets – primarily to support production and testing processes, as well as for the acquisition of office equipment.'

details.completeness_justification: K1 and K4 are fully covered with the required core figures and comparisons. K5 is adequately represented. K2 is only partially covered because the candidate omits the Q4 regional breakdown and the specific 40% decline / 24% increase / doubling figures. K3, K6, K7 and K8 are entirely absent.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent. Each sentence follows logically from the preceding ones: revenue decline (S2) is explained by regional performance (S3–S4), profitability metrics (S5–S8) are directly linked to the revenue contraction, operating expenses (S9–S10) are presented as stable despite lower sales, and the cash-flow and balance-sheet items (S12–S16) are shown as consistent with the reported net loss. No sentence contradicts another, and the narrative flows from performance description through financial position to forward-looking statements without repetition or structural gaps.
